_note: Gear and cards transcribed by hand from client item tooltips screenshotted in game by the SENAI guild. Only names the published sheets do not carry yet are in here; anything the sheets already list stays with the sheet so there is one entry per item. Several tooltips are cut off at the bottom in the screenshot, so the flavour text can be shorter than in game, and a mouse cursor sits over a few numbers, which is why some stat fields are empty rather than guessed.
_where: Nobody has documented where these drop. Every entry therefore ships the same honest placeholder instead of a location. The sheets do give a location for other pieces of six of these families, so the guess is Rgan Tunnels for Exuvic, Far North for Glacial, Thanatos Tower for Honor Guard and True Morpheus's/Morrigane's, Rgan Sacred Ground for Ascendant and Kiel D-01 for Apolytos, but a guess is not a source and none of it is written into the entries.
_skills: Exuvic Blessing, which half the Exuvic entries raise, is a passive with no listed maximum level: Atk and Matk +1% per level, and it drains 1% of Max HP every 5 seconds.
_source: In game item tooltips, screenshotted 17 Aug 2026.
